behavior: Only after CreateJobObjectW fails with immediate error 5, the same guardian tries OpenProcessToken on its own pseudo-process handle with TOKEN_QUERY mask 8 and closes any returned token handle. No token information, account/SID, raw handle, path or text is read/exported.

A fixed optional selfTokenQuery observation retains opened/error/closeError/handlesClosedVerified. Old frames without the field remain supported; malformed or unrelated observations refuse. Null means no observation.

The CI owner projects only qopen/qdenied/qfailed/qclose suffixes through its existing bounded phase label. It preserves original exceptions, no acknowledgement, RUNTIME_STOP_UNCONFIRMED and every original owner assertion.
